caption: Direct, all 30 nodes send 64-byte readings to the gateway: 2.7648 MB/day inbound. With clustering, three cluster heads each send one 128-byte aggregate every 60 s, so the gateway takes in only 0.55296 MB/day — one-fifth. The dashed arrow is the direct path that clustering replaces; node-to-head traffic still flows.

spec.aria: Thirty sensor nodes send 64-byte readings every 60 s to three cluster heads, which forward one 128-byte aggregate each per minute, cutting gateway inbound from 2.7648 MB/day to 0.55296 MB/day.
